twitter_thread: QA reporting is still manual at most companies. Here's why — and what live dashboards look like when the tooling is right. 🧵
The access problem: most test management tools require an account to view any data. Teams solve this by exporting and sending manually rather than adding users who only need read access.
The staleness problem: exported reports are snapshots. By the time a CSV is formatted and shared, the data is out of date. Stakeholders stop trusting it and start asking for live updates.

TestFiesta dashboards: shareable via link, no account required, updates in real time. Share the link in Slack at sprint start. Stakeholders check it themselves. QA lead stops being the reporting bottleneck.
